# easyui (MIT, © 2026 Suraj Maurya) — source copied from github.com/Surajmaurya1/easyui
Modified for the MBZUH CE v12 demo:
- GooeyMenu: brand surface colour (#0f1a16) and gold active dot/focus ring.
- PillNavigation: optional controlled `value` (scroll-spy), RTL arrow keys, Arabic type size, submenu text contrast raised to AA.
- UnfoldAccordion: logical (RTL) alignment and margins, larger Arabic type.
- MorphingDialog: Arabic close label, close icon contrast.
- NeonEdgeLink.tsx: anchor variant of NeonEdgeButton (same beam/markup), gold beam, custom icon.
- registry/blocks/stats-band: aria-label 'Key numbers' translated to Arabic.
- registry/blocks/logo-marquee: UI strings translated to Arabic.
- registry/components/countdown: unit names translated to Arabic.
- registry/components/countdown: digit run forced dir=ltr so two-digit numbers read correctly inside RTL pages.
